_source.title: 移除私有消息总线
_source.remarks.text.0: 一般无需调用该方法，除非你知道自己在做什么
_source.example.text.0: 1. 订阅一个主题并验证能收到消息
_source.example.text.1: 2. 移除私有消息总线，原有订阅全部失效
_source.example.text.2: 3. 再次订阅，总线自动重建恢复正常

title: Remove Private message bus
remarks.text.0: Generally, there is no need to call this method unless you know what you are doing
